# Privacy Policy

This Privacy Policy (this "Policy") explains how Hibari Lab Inc. ("Hibari Lab", "we" or "us") handles the personal information of Users in the Hibari Diary app (the "Service").

## 1. Information We Collect

1.1 We collect the following information from people who use the Service ("Users"):

- name, email address and date of birth;
- the diary entries and photos you add to the Service; and
- your device type, operating system version and access times.

## 2. How We Use Information

2.1 We use personal information for the following three purposes:

- to provide the Service and verify your identity;
- to send you notices about the Service;
- to prevent fraudulent use; and
- to produce statistics that help us improve the Service.

## 3. Sharing

3.1 We do not share personal information with third parties without your prior consent, except where the law requires it.

## 4. Retention

4.1 When you close your account, we keep your personal information for one (1) year from the closing date and then delete it.

## 5. Your Rights

5.1 Users may ask us to disclose, correct or delete their personal information.

5.2 We accept requests under Section 5.1 through the contact point in Section 9.

5.3 We will verify your identity and reply within fourteen (14) days of receiving a request.

5.4 Even without a request, we delete personal information three (3) years after the account was closed.

## 6. Data Breaches

6.1 If a breach affects your personal information, we will notify you promptly after becoming aware of it.

## 7. Contact

7.1 Send questions about this Policy by email to our privacy team:

- Team: Hibari Lab Privacy Office
- Email: privacy@hibari-lab.example

## 8. Changes to This Policy

8.1 We will post any change to this Policy in the Service at least fourteen (14) days before it takes effect. Questions about a change can be sent to privacy@hibarilab.example.
